skill: Electric guitar technique with pentatonic scales and loop pedal usage

capabilities.name: Basic guitar technique and posture
capabilities.description: Demonstrate foundational guitar handling, fretting cleanly, controlled picking, and ergonomic posture suitable for looping practice.
observable_behaviors: Holds the guitar with relaxed shoulders and proper strap height
Fingers fretting cleanly with minimal pressure
Right-hand picking is controlled and smooth
Maintains neutral wrist and back posture during practice
common_failure_modes: Tension in shoulders or back causing discomfort
Muted or buzzed notes due to poor fretting
Poor picking technique leading to inconsistent tone

capabilities.name: Identify pentatonic root notes on neck
capabilities.description: Recognize and name the root notes that anchor pentatonic shapes across the fretboard.
observable_behaviors: Names root notes on given shapes
Points to root notes on neck diagrams or on the fretboard
Explains how root notes define key for pentatonic shapes
common_failure_modes: Confusing root notes between major/minor contexts
Incorrectly labeling root notes leading to miskeyed improvisation

capabilities.name: Map five pentatonic patterns across the neck
capabilities.description: Know and connect the five pentatonic positions (patterns) and map their location on the neck.
observable_behaviors: Recites or sketches the five pentatonic patterns
Can locate patterns across strings without hesitation
Demonstrates movable shapes with correct fingering
common_failure_modes: Patterns viewed in isolation without neck-spread awareness

capabilities.name: Play pentatonic in two positions with clean tone
capabilities.description: Execute pentatonic scales across two adjacent positions with accurate fingering and consistent tone.
observable_behaviors: Clean tone across both positions
Accurate fingering with minimal string noise
Stable intonation within each position
common_failure_modes: Wrong fingering leading to ringing notes

capabilities.name: Smooth transitions between pentatonic positions
capabilities.description: Move fluidly between pentatonic positions while preserving key and fingerings.
observable_behaviors: Seamless shifts between positions at moderate tempo
No loss of tonal center while moving positions
Controlled right-hand picking during transitions
common_failure_modes: Unclear tonal center when shifting positions

capabilities.name: Maintain key/stability during improvisation
capabilities.description: Stay in the chosen key while using pentatonic shapes during improvisation.
observable_behaviors: Keeps tonal center despite licks
Uses scale positions without wandering into outside keys
Demonstrates correct note choices within the key
common_failure_modes: Overreliance on single position breaks key coherence

capabilities.name: Loop pedal: basic operation
capabilities.description: Power on, navigate basic functions (record, overdub, playback) on a loop pedal.
observable_behaviors: Turns pedal on/off
Initiates a loop with a clear count-in
Uses record and playback at appropriate times

capabilities.name: Record a basic looping track
capabilities.description: Create a first loop track (rhythm or bass-like) for backing.
observable_behaviors: Single-layer loop recorded on beat 1
Loop plays back cleanly without unintended noise
Able to listen to the loop while playing along
common_failure_modes: Rumbling or noise from strings not muted correctly

capabilities.name: Overdub a second layer on loop
capabilities.description: Add a melodic or rhythmic layer over an existing loop.
observable_behaviors: Records overdub in sync with existing loop
Maintains timing and muting to avoid clutter
Balances volume between layers
common_failure_modes: Overdubs out of time or too loud

capabilities.name: Layer rhythm and lead loops
capabilities.description: Create a simple multi-layer backing by adding rhythm and lead loops.
observable_behaviors: Two or more loops running simultaneously
Clear separation of rhythm and lead parts
Aligned loops in time with metronome

capabilities.name: Add melodic pentatonic phrase over loop
capabilities.description: Improvise a melodic phrase over the looped backing track.
observable_behaviors: Improvises 8–12 bars using pentatonic shapes
Phrasing fits the groove and key
Demonstrates motif development over time
common_failure_modes: Lack of melodic development across bars

capabilities.name: Blues improvisation over loop (8–12 bars)
capabilities.description: Create a blues melodic phrase using pentatonic shapes over the looped track.
observable_behaviors: Produces an 8–12 bar blues line
Uses call-and-response or motif development
Stays within the blues pentatonic framework
common_failure_modes: Loss of groove or time on blues phrasing

capabilities.name: Timing control with metronome
capabilities.description: Practice scales and improvisation aligned to a metronome; subdivide beats.
observable_behaviors: Able to play scales over metronome at target tempo
Maintains consistent subdivisions (eighths/ quarters)
Tempo increases gradually without losing accuracy

capabilities.name: Backing track context for blues
capabilities.description: Explain and apply pentatonic ideas within blues backing tracks.
observable_behaviors: Describes blues structure (12-bar)
Chooses pentatonic shapes appropriate to the key
Practices improvisation over blues backing track

capabilities.name: Tone control and clean input
capabilities.description: Dial in clean tone and manage input for loop playback.
observable_behaviors: Maintains clean signal with minimal noise
Uses volume/tade control to balance loops
Avoids excessive feedback or distortion
common_failure_modes: Excessive gain causing hiss or feedback

capabilities.name: Safe practice and ergonomics for looping
capabilities.description: Implement breaks, posture awareness, and safe loop usage to prevent strain.
observable_behaviors: Takes regular breaks during 30 min sessions
Maintains ergonomic posture and strap setup
Recognizes early signs of strain and adjusts technique

capabilities.name: Tuning stability and tuner usage
capabilities.description: Tune the guitar accurately and maintain tuning during practice.
observable_behaviors: Uses tuner to verify pitch
Re-tunes as needed between phrases
Maintains pitch stability during loops
common_failure_modes: Over-tightening or poor bridge setup affecting intonation

capabilities.name: Expand across different keys and tempos
capabilities.description: Apply pentatonic shapes to new keys and varied tempos.
observable_behaviors: Transposes pentatonic shapes to a new key
Keeps groove and phrasing at faster/slower tempos
Maintains accuracy while adapting fingering

capabilities.name: Muting and articulation in loop context
capabilities.description: Use muting techniques to maintain clean loop layers and articulate notes clearly.
observable_behaviors: Left-hand muting to control noise between notes
Right-hand muting to separate phrases
Clear articulation without accidental string noise in loops

capabilities.name: Avoid muddiness when overdubbing multiple layers
capabilities.description: Limit layers and manage levels to keep groove clear.
observable_behaviors: Plans overdub order to avoid crowding
Balances volume across loops
Assessment and adjustment of layering depth
common_failure_modes: Poor level control obscuring lead lines

capabilities.name: Navigate pentatonic positions across neck
capabilities.description: Connect pentatonic shapes across neck for seamless playing.
observable_behaviors: Describes voice-leading across neck
Moves fluidly across multiple positions while staying in key
Maintains melodic contour across transitions
common_failure_modes: Loss of tonal center during long phrases

capabilities.name: Voice-leading with pentatonic shapes
capabilities.description: Apply melodic voice-leading when moving through pentatonic shapes to create connected lines.
observable_behaviors: Creates smooth melodic lines across shapes
Maintains emphasis on root and chord tones
Demonstrates musical phrasing bridges between shapes
common_failure_modes: Lack of directional motion in lines

capabilities.name: Complete loop flow: rhythm + lead chain
capabilities.description: Execute a full sequence: record rhythm, overdub lead, playback, and switch to performance mode.
observable_behaviors: Rhythm loop plays in sync with lead overdub
Timing is consistent across play/overdub cycles
Able to start playback cleanly without lag
common_failure_modes: Ghost notes or stray ticks during playback

capabilities.name: Safety and feedback during loop practice
capabilities.description: Monitor safety and respond to feedback from peers or observers about technique and setup.
observable_behaviors: Solicits feedback from peers or instructor
Adjusts technique based on feedback
Reports any discomfort or pain promptly

capabilities.name: Assess and adjust timing drift
capabilities.description: Identify timing drift in loops and improvisation and correct it.
observable_behaviors: Detects timing drift with metronome and loops
Adjusts tempo or phrasing to re-align with beat
Re-records sections to restore groove
common_failure_modes: Late or early notes causing groove break

capabilities.name: Tonal center and key recognition
capabilities.description: Identify the tonal center and key for a given pentatonic pattern or blues backing track.
observable_behaviors: Names key and scales used in a track
Chooses appropriate pentatonic shapes for the key
Demonstrates consistent application of scale tones
common_failure_modes: Misidentifying key leading to wrong shapes
Failure to align with backing track harmony

capabilities.name: Ergonomic warmups for loop sessions
capabilities.description: Perform warmups focusing on hand/wrist alignment to reduce strain during looping.
observable_behaviors: Completes a short warmup sequence
Maintains relaxed hands and wrists during practice
Notices early signs of fatigue and adjusts routine

capabilities.name: Record and analyze loop performance
capabilities.description: Record practice sessions and assess performance for improvement.
observable_behaviors: Records a session and stores for review
Notes specific improvements and actions
Implements changes in next practice based on analysis

capabilities.name: Dynamic control and phrasing variety
capabilities.description: Use dynamics, articulation, and phrasing to color pentatonic lines within blues context.
observable_behaviors: Uses volume/picking dynamics to shape phrases
Applies accents and pauses for color
Explores effects of phrasing variety over loops
common_failure_modes: Over-usage of same phrase without variation

assumptions: Practices 30 minutes per day, 5 days per week
Access to loop pedal capable of recording, overdubbing, and playback
Standard tuning and basic amp settings assumed
Practice environment allows use of a metronome
No external performance requirement during the horizon
unresolved_questions: Exact sequencing order for beginners can vary between curricula; some sources emphasize five-position system while others discuss two-position drills initially.
Hardware details of loop pedals differ (memory, overdub capabilities) and may affect practice workflows; specific loop device features cited across sources vary.
Some sources are community forums or blog posts; their guidance may be less authoritative than Berklee/JustinGuitar pages.
